label: verify-historical-source-archives
command:
import hashlib, json, tarfile
from pathlib import Path
base = Path("reproduction/sources")
manifest = json.loads((base / "manifest.json").read_text())
output = Path("artifacts/engine-historical-replay-001")
output.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
for record in manifest["archives"]:
    path = base / record["path"]
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    assert len(raw) == record["bytes"]
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == record["sha256"]
    expected = {m["path"]: m for m in record["members"]}
    target = output / record["path"].removesuffix(".tar.gz")
    with tarfile.open(path) as archive:
        members = archive.getmembers()
        assert len(members) == len(expected)
        assert {m.name for m in members} == set(expected)
        assert sum(m.size for m in members) < 16 * 1024**2
        for member in members:
            name = Path(member.name)
            assert member.isfile() and not name.is_absolute() and ".." not in name.parts
            data = archive.extractfile(member).read()
            assert len(data) == expected[member.name]["bytes"]
            assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == expected[member.name]["sha256"]
            destination = target / name
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with destination.open("xb") as stream:
                stream.write(data)
    print(record["path"], len(members), record["execution_revision"], record["evaluator_revision"])
